why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open trynoah.ai and check the address in your browser. Several unrelated products use the Noah name, and noah.ai is not this project's site.
Sign in with a wallet, Google or X. The free plan gives 1 million credits a month and one project.

Open the Noah ID page, connect your X account and try the daily chest. Warning Check what a connection lets Noah do before you approve it. Noah's consent page for connected accounts reads: "I authorise and instruct Noah AI to access and operate my connected account on my behalf".
If you get an ID, share it on X and keep @TryNoahAI in the post. The app says that is what unlocks the point allocation.
Build something and post about it if you want credits. Tag @TryNoahAI on X, then submit the link in the app.
costs: Noah IDs and the free plan cost nothing. The product itself is paid: plans run from 10 to 100 US dollars a month, and the terms say "all payments made for access to the Services are non-refundable." Deploying an app to mainnet needs real SOL in a deployment wallet that Noah generates for you. The Plans and Credits page in the Noah AI docs on 18 October 2026, listing the free plan first. Source: No
risks: The word allocation comes with no rules. Nothing says what the points are worth, when they are counted or whether they lead to a token. Getting an ID depends on a daily draw, and unlocking it takes a public post on X. Credits for posts are judged by Noah. The app says: "Bad posts won't get rewards."
